description: This file implements the Netlink communication mechanism within the Thunder project, including serialization, deserialization, sending, and receiving of netlink messages, as well as managing communication state.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Class handling serialization and deserialization of netlink messages, maintaining sequence ID.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Derived class managing socket communication for netlink messages, including send and receive operations.

methods.name: uint16_t Serialize(uint8_t stream[],const uint16_t length) const
methods.description: Serializes a netlink message into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: uint16_t Deserialize(const uint8_t stream[],const uint16_t streamLength)
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a netlink message, processing incoming data.

methods.name: uint32_t Send(const Core::Netlink & outbound,const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Sends a netlink message over the socket, waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: uint32_t Exchange(const Core::Netlink & outbound,Core::Netlink & inbound,const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Performs a request-response exchange of netlink messages.

methods.name: uint16_t SendData(uint8_t * dataFrame,const uint16_t maxSendSize)
methods.description: Prepares data to be sent over the socket.

methods.name: uint16_t ReceiveData(uint8_t * dataFrame,const uint16_t receivedSize)
methods.description: Handles incoming data, processing responses and updating message states.

methods.name: void StateChange()
methods.description: Placeholder for signaling state changes in the socket connection.

methods.name: void DumpFrame(const TCHAR prefix[],const uint8_t frame[],const uint16_t length)
